description: 1. Agent reads `config/policies/workspace_policy.json` to understand the assignment rules (firefox/chromium→web, code/nvim→code, spotify/vlc→media, alacritty→terminal, slack=unmatched/leave). 2. Agent discovers the skill scripts at `./skills/niri-ipc/scripts/` and sets/confirms `NIRI_SOCKET=/tmp/niri_mock.sock`. 3. Agent uses `niri.py workspaces` and `niri_ctl.py list-windows` (or `niri.py windows`) to capture the before-state showing all 8 windows on workspace 1. 4. Agent uses `niri_ctl.py move-to-workspace <app_id_substr> <workspace_name>` (the proprietary trap: substring matching by name, NOT by window ID) to move firefox→web, chromium→web, code→code, nvim (via title match)→code, spotify→media, vlc→media. Alacritty terminals stay on terminal (already there). Slack is skipped. 5. Agent re-queries the window state for the after snapshot. 6. Agent writes `workspace_audit.json` with 'before' and 'after' sections. The mock server persists mutations to `/tmp/niri_mock_state.json`, which the evaluator reads to verify actual IPC calls were made with the correct workspace name references.
